cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I took your bins out once during your holiday. I didn't volunteer for life. Tonight's yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The neighbours already send you the reminders.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll introduce you in the group as their permanent bin contact.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stay in it until I know what I'm doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay until you send 'I'll handle Thursday.' They can welcome you while I leave.

mechanism: A corrects the difference between temporary cover and permanent responsibility to hand B bins back through precise message and timetable instructions.
confusable: Generic refusal would leave the task unclaimed; A must secure B explicit acceptance of a duty A believes never belonged to A.
comparison: Bathroom alternative teaches physical technique; bins alternative repairs the communication chain that wrongly made A permanent contact.
seedUse: Holiday bin cover and neighbour reminder group derive from D29-b; S03 adds exact rota and message wording as competent handover practice.
